scope: Read-only CPU source audit of enabled-domain and two UB branches; no NPU execution or numerical/performance claim.
source_identity: All five local audit sources match the independently read hashes of the actual adaptive-release-build source on a3-194.

guard.bf16_contract: GMM_ANTI_QUANT_A8W4_MSD_OUT_BF16 is defined only for ORIG_DTYPE_X INT8, ORIG_DTYPE_WEIGHT INT4 and ORIG_DTYPE_Y BF16; otherwise helper.enabled remains false.
guard.count_contract: Every registered A8W4 MSD API-dequant instantiation selects GROUP_LIST_TYPE_COUNT. COUNT is a template-registration invariant, not an explicit field test in helper.Init.
guard.count_non_evidence: input-param.json has default group_list_type=0; those descriptor defaults do not establish the actual runtime group-list mode. Use the template whitelist and bound runtime key.
guard.format_contract: Builder replaces only pinned INT8 x NZ INT4 -> BF16 variant a0be48d01b162435398ed52e1b6182d4, preserves other variants by symlink, and compares compiled descriptor fields against the original. FORMAT_WEIGHT selects CubeFormat::NZ for this artifact.
guard.negative_boundaries: K !=128, N !=6144, E !=256, M=0 or M>256, nonzero offset, preNZ, grouped weight scale, other core/parall count or multi-tensor input all disable the helper; FP16 disables it at preprocessing.
guard.conclusion: No cross-shape use of hardcoded retile fields in this pinned B114 artifact. The helper alone is not a portable COUNT validator for a different registration set.

ub.unused_view: buffer6 is still constructed with relative view [98304,163840), beyond the 131072-byte allocation, but withOffset=0 never reads or writes it. This change bounds all accessed views, not every constructed view.
ub.layout_invariant: tmpBuff is the last InitBuffer call. Its larger extent keeps its base and all earlier queue/view addresses unchanged; no later local allocation is displaced. Publisher/pre storage is reset before the mid-stage allocations. Matmul shareUbSize is zero.
ub.indices_invariant: All scratch indexing depends on ubCalSize and computeSize, not ubRestBytes; raising only InitBuffer length does not change arithmetic or indices. Both active tilings have computeSize <=8192.
ub.disabled_fallback: When helper.enabled is false, allocation remains exactly tiling->ubRestBytes and original indexing/barrier path remains; this patch does not claim to repair the inherited declared-bound behavior outside its enabled domain.
ub.conclusion: Wide and enabled COUNT>16 fallback fit physical UB and their used tmp views fit the new declared length; no adjacent allocation or index changes were found.
